errors.evidence: The description does not specify what the units of the horizontal axis represent. It correctly identifies the range (0-40) and intervals (10) but only refers to them as "values" ("стойностите"). It fails to clarify that these values are absolute counts, which correspond to the first number in the data labels for each bar (e.g., 36, 29, 12). This information is essential for understanding what the length of the bars signifies.
